notes.title: Release Notes - 25M0731 alpha-b151432
notes.notes:
Improvements to the Vehicle Assembly Building
We have improved the functionality of the Vehicle Assembly Building where rockets are assembled.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203224/6543256b36022f6a73adeb4a4188ece570c5761f.jpg"]
Registering user texture images
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203224/8d75e43cb9e05354a992aeec265d1242d3c06f31.jpg"]

You can register your favorite texture images from the “Texture” menu at the top of the screen.

The texture images registered here can be applied to rocket parts.


Parts Editor
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203224/d3831b7edd9e78ee3887875072eff72d3e3c35f3.png"]

Right-clicking on a rocket part opens the Parts Editor. In the Parts Editor, you can change the color, texture, scale, and other properties.


Linear Symmetry Placement
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203224/a3d21101ddf914dda8a167b4d77144314a496e00.png"]

By selecting options such as ×3 or ×4 from the top of the screen, you can duplicate and place parts in linear symmetry.

notes.title: Release Notes - 25M0703 alpha-b165837:Hot fix
notes.notes:
A version with bug fixes will be released.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203224/79ea80cca4aef707ca25f4835f0b51350326468c.jpg"]
[olist]
Fixed an issue where the game would crash when placing celestial bodies in the debug console.

Improved camera parallel movement in VAB.

We have enabled parallel movement of the camera by clicking the middle mouse button and dragging.

You can now select the era.
[/olist]

notes.title: Release Notes - 25M0630 alpha-b214915
notes.notes:
We made it possible to assemble rockets in the Vehicle Assembly Building (VAB) and launch them.

We made it possible to accelerate time during rocket launches.

We improved the freedom of camera operation at the rocket launch site.

We made it possible to save rocket launch parameters for each rocket.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203224/a934f9ecf0d0531331657b6eaab6cc8e23499a6b.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203224/d906252a108befb821203a549173d9eeafa03bff.jpg"]

notes.title: Release Notes - 25M0531 alpha-b193032
notes.notes: Added Bowen Orbital Spaceport launch site

notes.title: Release Notes - 25M0506 alpha-b213740
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203224/5c1c5e4e3772edbc9790d364e375c0e33bfb9cc9.jpg
 Added focus function for target of interest
When the camera mode is in orbit mode, you can now center the target celestial object.
 Planned orbit line drawing
Planned orbit line drawing after SOI change is now also performed. This function will be improved in the future.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203224/6eae02c24f75c5aa576a13b0e82ce46252da49af.jpg
 Added space walk mini game
You can enjoy the space walk mini game from the ISS.
 Bug fixes
Fixed some bugs.

notes.title: Release Notes - 25M0325 alpha-b153308
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203224/08b39f47012cf90d7dc421453f35a53d68f3bf39.png

 It is now possible to create maneuver plans for lunar flyby trajectories.
 Added quick save (F5 key)/load (F9 key).
 Improved camera behavior when left-clicking and dragging in Free/Orbital camera mode.
 The SOI sphere displayed by the F3 key now only shows the targeted celestial body.
 The distance display unit has been abolished from mm to km.

[previewyoutube=DLPqzpTLdrI;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Release Notes - 25M0301 alpha-b105635
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203224/d592ec28ccc6a03f49d640b541a986125524f173.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203224/7ab24c274cf130e75b05dc0ebea37cd0a9765992.jpg

 Maneuvers can now be created/executed.
 You can now change the design of Navball.
 Improved Navball behavior.
 Satellites can now be selected from the contract list.
 Increased the maximum magnification of time acceleration.
 The display location of the azimuth angle has been changed.

notes.title: Release Notes - 25M0207 alpha-b094410
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45203224/826028ecdfa766c9d6365459d887752246c26826.jpg

notes.notes:

 Satellite Operation Agreement
 Allow company icons to be specified
 Add information display content with target
 Minor bug fixes

notes.title: Release Notes - 24M1230 alpha-b211429

Improved ISS internal performance.
 Improved behavior when scaling is other than 100%.
